about-us.heading: OUR STORY BEGAN WITH A NEED
about-us.body: When Ken Adams began pastoring Crossroads Church in 1989, he envisioned that church becoming a part of the mission and movement of Jesus by making and multiplying disciples. The church needed a curriculum that would drive the goals and strategy its leadership had established, but there was a problem…

about-us.heading: MORE ABOUT OUR MINISTRY
about-us.body: Did you know that we have Disciple-Making Churches and pastors all over the world in our disciple making network? We’d love to connect you to other ministry partners pursuing the same goals with the same passion and dedication as you.

about-us.heading: WHY CHOOSE US
about-us.body: Jesus spent time one-on-one with His disciples, but then He took them out into the wide world to apply what they had learned with Him in a small group setting. Our director began his ministry based on Jesus’ strategy using Jesus’ methods in the early 1990s and has continued refining those efforts to the present day.

about-us.heading: OUR MISSION
about-us.body:
Impact Discipleship Ministries exists to inspire people and churches to be and build disciples of Jesus Christ.

We provide disciple making resources, training, and consultations. We help people explore the concepts of disciple making, we educate people and churches in the principles of disciple making, we assist people and churches to establish disciple-making movements, and engage individuals and churches in developing movements of multiplication.

items.description: Ken Adams was called as the first pastor of Crossroads Church in Newnan, Georgia in 1989. He was passionate about the Great Commission and wanted his church to be a part of the movement and mission of Jesus. Ken wanted everything at Crossroads to revolve around being and building disciples of Jesus.

In the early 1990s, Crossroads was well on its way multiplying disciples, but the church was having a major problem finding resources that would accomplish its mission. While a lot of resources provided insight on how to have a discipleship program in a church, there were few resources that taught how to build a church that entirely revolved around a Jesus-style strategy for disciple making.

Out of this need, Ken began writing his own curriculum for Crossroads. He emphasized important topics in his writing like how to define a disciple, how to train a disciple, how to multiply disciples, and how to create church and small group environments that multiply disciples. Ken’s curriculum was a huge hit with the Crossroads, and pretty soon, disciples and small groups were multiplying exponentially in the church.

Under Ken’s leadership, Crossroads has grown to 3,000+ in attendance, meets on three campuses, and has planted eight other churches as of 2020. In 2001, Ken decided to make his resources available to other churches. He founded Impact Discipleship Ministries as a non-profit of Crossroads Church specifically for the purpose of providing disciple making resources and training. Today, Impact Discipleship Ministries serves pastors, churches, and individuals all over the world.

about-us.heading: 15
about-us.body:
Impact works with churches, pastors, and individuals all over the world to be and build disciples of Jesus.

We currently have Disciple-Making Church partners in the United States, Montenegro, Brazil, Dominican Republic, Haiti, the Philippines, Zambia, India, Thailand, Kosovo, Albania, Serbia, Italy, Cambodia, and closed countries that will not be listed here for safety purposes.

equipping-groups.heading: OUR APPROACH TO EQUIPPING
equipping-groups.body:
Impact Discipleship Equipping Groups are designed to help pastors and church leaders rediscover and live out Jesus’ original vision for the church—a movement of multiplying disciples.

Drawing from over 30 years of real-life ministry experience, these small-group learning environments invite leaders to study the life and methods of Jesus alongside other like-minded pastors and leaders.

Through short videos, focused articles, and live Zoom discussions, each equipping group provides practical, biblical insight you can immediately apply in your local church.

It’s a simple investment that produces lasting impact—helping you lead, build, and multiply disciples the way Jesus intended.

equipping-groups-pastors.heading: The Making of a Disciple-Making Pastor
OUR APPROACH TO EQUIPPING PASTORS
equipping-groups-pastors.body:
Many pastors today have not been personally discipled and lack disciple-making training in their theological education. Our course seeks to address this gap by providing pastors with the tools to become influential disciple-making leaders in their churches.

Drawing on over 30 years of “on-the-job” disciple-making experience, we offer a strategic and intentional process for pastors seeking to lead their congregations toward becoming movements of multiplication. The course covers six crucial priorities of Disciple-Making Pastors, modeled after Jesus’ approach to disciple-making.

The course consists of seven online sessions where pastors meet with a group of twelve peers to discuss the strategic content developed by our team. Pastors will receive personalized coaching and accountability throughout the course to help them develop the necessary skills to fulfill Jesus’ mission of making disciples.

As a pastor, the course creator, Ken Adams, knows firsthand the challenges of leading a church to become a Disciple-Making Movement. He is committed to sharing the most important things he has learned about this ministry to help pastors progress as Disciple-Making Pastors.

Join us in “The Making of a Disciple-Making Pastor” group and take the first step towards leading your congregation to fulfill the mission of making disciples.

items.title: Six Priorities of a Disciple-Making Leader
items.body:
A Disciple-Making Leader:
  1. Knows the Mission - Understands God’s heart and purpose for making disciples.
  2. Models the Mission - Lives out disciple-making through personal obedience and example.
  3. Executes the Mission - Takes intentional steps to disciple others in everyday life and ministry.
  4. Multiplies the Mission - Helps disciples become disciple-makers.
  5. Protects the Mission - Guards the focus and values of disciple-making within the church.
  6. Finishes the Mission - Perseveres faithfully, passing the mission on to the next generation.

coaching-with-impact.heading: Step onto your “field” of influence with purpose and impact.
coaching-with-impact.body:
Through a clear biblical framework, Coaching With Impact empowers coaches to embrace their role as disciple-makers, guiding them to develop both personally and professionally. Join us on this transformative journey as we equip coaches to lead with authenticity, intentionality, and lasting impact.

Drawing from his experiences as a former Professional Baseball player and Major League Baseball scout, Kevin Burrell has partnered with Ken Adams, Impact Discipleship Ministries’ founder and director, in inviting coaches of all levels to rediscover the essence of Jesus Christ’s final command – the ‘Great Commission.’

coaching-with-impact.heading: Check out how coaches are using our resource
Progress Report
coaching-with-impact.body: Hear from Kevin Burrell, Major League Baseball Scout, as he discusses the ways he shares Jesus Christ with scouts, coaches, and more. From Bible studies to baptisms, learn how the Lord is making disciples and working in Kevin and the Sport Industry.

items.title: Coaching With Impact Resource
items.body:
Every coach has a certain level of influence both on and off the field. How a coach leverages this influence is critical. Coaching with Impact is designed for coaches to come alongside each other in the context of a small group and maximize the influence God has given them to multiply disciples in the world of sports.

Coaching with Impact will teach coaches how to coach and lead with the Character and Conduct of Christ, so they can in turn reproduce those same principles in the lives of other coaches.

items.title: Competing With Impact Resource
items.body: Athletes of all ages have a tremendous opportunity to influence others around them for the sake of Christ. In this ten-week course, you will discover how to leverage your influence to make a difference on and off the field for Christ.

coaching-with-impact.heading: A movement of multiplication
coaching-with-impact.body: Over 90 baseball coaches and pro scouts came together to participate in our 2025 Zoom online discipleship group. We are praying for a movement of multiplication to take place in the lives of coaches and athletes all across America.

coaching-with-impact.heading: First “Competing with Impact” High School Discipleship Group at ECHS

image.name: The first Competing with Impact high school discipleship group at East Coweta High School

coaching-with-impact.body:
What an incredible moment to witness. We celebrated the very first Competing with Impact high school discipleship group at East Coweta High School, led by none other than Coach Mark Bowles.

Coach Mark, who was discipled by Kevin Burrell, is now stepping into leadership and pouring into the next generation of disciples. It’s amazing to see the impact of this mentorship come full circle — Mark is now leading his own group, making disciples, and empowering students to grow in their faith.

Excited to see how God continues to move through this group and the lives of these students. Let’s keep praying for the students of ECHS and leaders like Coach Mark Bowles, who are living out the call to make disciples.
